description: This bar chart illustrates the distribution of tokens across different categories of text used in a language model training dataset. The horizontal axis represents the categories, labeled “Administrative,” “Religion,” “Non-fiction,” “Fiction,” “Law,” “Science,” and “Blogs,” presented in an unspecified order. The vertical axis, labeled “Tokens (K),” represents the count of tokens, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 10584, incrementing by 2000. There are seven individual bars, each representing a category; all bars are light blue. The “Administrative” category has a bar with a height of approximately 6472 tokens, while “Religion” has a bar of approximately 652 tokens. The “Non-fiction” category is represented by a bar of approximately 1889 tokens, and “Fiction” by a bar of approximately 387 tokens. “Law” has a bar of approximately 354 tokens, “Science” has a bar of approximately 1626 tokens, and “Blogs” has a bar of approximately 32 tokens. No bars are visually emphasized, and no grouping or stacking is present.
